name: GDMenu
description: Bot (.gdbot, resume), frame stepper, noclip, speedhack, hitboxes, start-pos switcher, custom click sounds, win screenshots, warm-up mode, bot speed control, FPS counter, themes & more. Thanks to prevxGD for infinitely upgrading the mod

step-key.name: Frame Step Key
step-key.description: Key that advances one frame while the frame stepper is on (single letter).

toggle-stepper-key.name: Toggle Stepper Key
toggle-stepper-key.description: Key that turns the frame stepper on/off (single letter).

resume-speed.name: Resume Speed
resume-speed.description: Game speed while fast-forwarding back to where you left off.

speedhack.name: Speedhack Value
speedhack.description: Game speed when Speedhack is on.

startpos-prev-key.name: StartPos Previous Key
startpos-prev-key.description: PC key for previous start position.

startpos-next-key.name: StartPos Next Key
startpos-next-key.description: PC key for next start position.

hud-scale.name: Button Size
hud-scale.description: Size of the floating GDM bubble and the stepper touch buttons.

stepper-touch-controls.name: Stepper Touch Buttons
stepper-touch-controls.description: +1 / +10 / Play buttons shown ONLY while the frame stepper is on. 'auto' = phones only. Nothing else is ever shown during gameplay.

auto-save-bot.name: Auto-Save Bot
auto-save-bot.description: Saves your recording as <level name>.gdbot in the bots folder when you complete the level while recording (toggle also in the Bot tab).

bot-play-speed.name: Bot Play Speed
bot-play-speed.description: How fast a bot plays its run. 1.0 = normal speed. The Bot tab has a quick 0.5x - 2x cycle button.

bot-stop-on-death.name: Stop Bot on Death
bot-stop-on-death.description: If the player dies while a bot is playing (usually a desync), GDMenu stops the playback instead of continuing.

hud.name: In-game Status
hud.description: Small indicator in the top-right corner while playing showing which hacks are active (NC, SPD, AC, STEP) plus the bot state (REC / PLAY). 'active' = only when something is on, 'always' = always show, 'off' = never. Toggle also in the Tools tab.

hud-fps.name: FPS Counter
hud-fps.description: Show your current FPS in the in-game status corner.

practice-fix.name: Practice Fix
practice-fix.description: Restore exact player physics when respawning at a checkpoint while recording. Without this, bots recorded in practice mode can desync and die on playback.

input-fix.name: Physics Fix
input-fix.description: While recording, the player's position/speed is saved every tick; playback follows that exact path. Stops bots recorded in practice mode from dying.

auto-checkpoint.name: Auto-Checkpoint
auto-checkpoint.description: In practice mode, automatically places a checkpoint at your furthest point when you die.

warmup-mode.name: Warm-Up Mode
warmup-mode.description: Attempts don't count - the attempt counter stays frozen at the value from when the level was opened.

editor-practice.name: Practice in Editor
editor-practice.description: Noclip, hitboxes and the frame stepper also work in the editor's test-play.

death-slowmo.name: Death Slow-Mo
death-slowmo.description: Time briefly slows down when you die, so the death lands. Only while playing normally (not while a bot has control).

click-sound.name: Click Sound
click-sound.description: File name of the .mp3/.wav/.ogg in the clicksounds folder used for jump clicks. Empty = original sound.

hardest-id.name: Hardest Level ID
hardest-id.description: Level ID you are conquering. On a clean win GDMenu saves a screenshot to the newhardestpictures folder. 0 = off.

win-screenshot.name: Screenshot on Win
win-screenshot.description: Also save a screenshot when you beat ANY level cleanly (files are named win_<id>-<time>.png).

panic-key.name: Panic Key
panic-key.description: Pressing this key turns every hack off at once.

custom-accent.name: Custom Accent
custom-accent.description: Use your own accent colour for the mod UI instead of the theme's.

menu-key.name: Menu Key (PC)
menu-key.description: Key that opens/closes the GDMenu panel on PC - left or right Control by default. Any key name works (LeftControl, RightControl, F6, G, ...). Leave empty to use the floating bubble instead.

attempt-cap.name: Attempt Cap
attempt-cap.description: After this many attempts in one level, GDMenu tells you to take a break (0 = off).

break-time.name: Break Time (minutes)
break-time.description: How long the break is after you hit the attempt cap. A BRK tag shows in the in-game status while it runs.
